[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Design Bitset** [LC 2166 · Design Bitset](https://leetcode.com/problems/design-bitset/){difficulty="Medium"}

`flip()` touches every bit, so doing it eagerly costs $O(n)$ per call. Store the bits *relative to* a global flag instead: the true bit $i$ is `stored[i] XOR flipped`. A flip only toggles the flag and replaces the count of ones by `size - ones`. This is a lazy reset (@sec-ds-a5) whose "clock" has only two values.

[Solved in full in @sec-ds-p5-bitset.]{.card-link}

:::
